notes: Run of 2026-11-13. Two stories read: the Museum of Illusions opening earns an entry. The four-part Sheng Thao series is an Oakland trial; its one address (1241 High Street) is in Oakland.

findings.description: The Museum of Illusions opens its San Francisco location, a 7,000-plus square foot interactive museum, at 735 Market Street on Friday 13 November 2026.

citation.label: The Voice of San Francisco, “The Museum of Illusions opens in San Francisco,” 12 November 2026

raw.text: The Museum of Illusions will open its San Francisco location at 735 Market Street , steps from Yerba Buena Gardens, Moscone Center, and Union Square, on Friday, Nov. 13.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 735 MARKET ST → parcel 3706061; sf-parcels has blklot 3706061 active, 735–735 MARKET; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1907.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/south-of-market/market-street/735/ (the-voice-sf-2026-11-13), dated to the opening day the article gives, and card on the homepage grid. Nothing for building: the Carroll and Tilton Building's name and architect are already on the page.
